objective: T-20260929-37: after the owner opened short selling of easy-to-borrow names, decide whether any of three low-turnover market-neutral directions (dual-class share pair z-score, ETF-crash constituent laggards vs short ETF, sector-SPDR intramonth momentum) reaches K1/K2 or watch_recent under the frozen contract with realistic short costs. Registry rows dir:dual_class_share_arbitrage_pwb, dir:etf_constituent_lead_lag_reversion, dir:sectoral_intramonth_momentum. How this gets to profit faster: all three are ETB-liquid, need only local SIP daily data and are the cheapest short-side candidates left in the retriage list; a clean negative removes three queued rows, a pass gives a market-neutral sleeve that can raise S3 Sharpe (K2).
target_regime_and_horizon: Frozen screen_lane windows: anchor 2024-01-08..2026-09-17 (judged), select 2023-09-18..2025-12-31, stress 2016-05-02..2023-09-15 (starts about 2017-01 for 252-day signals), holdout 2026-01-02..2026-09-17 reference only. Monthly (21 offsets) and weekly (5) rebalance for pairs; entry delay 0/1/2 for the ETF event book; single calendar version for the intramonth composite. Regime claims: dual-class ratio mean-reverts within weeks; ETF crash days over-shoot constituents for 5-10 sessions; month-end liquidity demand drives a D+1/D+2/D-10 cycle. Validity period: the intramonth cycle is a calendar effect that shifted by one day after T+1 settlement (May 2024); invalidation signal for any kept candidate: trailing-12-month Sharpe below 0.
existing_solution_comparison: No off-the-shelf product exists for any of the three. Direction A: the paperswithbacktest page for Untying the Knot says 'No backtest' (opened 2026-09-29), so the registry's 5.20% CAGR / Sharpe 1.68 is unverified and the paper's only rule is a short-interest double sort, not a class-price-ratio pair; the local pair z-score is motivated by twin-stock papers (Yang 2025 GOOGL/GOOG OU spread, Sharpe 5+ under a 0.001 cost, not credible as tradable) and is an untested construction. Direction B: the single hobby repo (Naut1cal5/etf-arbitrage-info-diffusion, opened) reports Sharpe 1.2-1.3 for a one-day-hold daily book without borrow cost; a daily-turnover version is what failed in T-20260929-32, so the low-turnover 5/10-day hold is the untested part; Ben-David et al. and Hou say the effect resolves within a day. Direction C: Quantpedia article opened (rules extracted exactly) with gross composite Sharpe 0.54-0.55 and no cost model; the underlying Nathan-Suominen-Tasa paper is single-stock (search summary only).
remaining_evidence_gap: Constituent lists for direction B are fixed 2016 top-10 holdings written from memory of the fund (approximate, not a point-in-time holdings file, survivor bias); UA/UAA and FOX/FOXA class identities changed over the sample; borrow tiers by dollar volume are a preregistered assumption (Alpaca publishes only current fees, paper does not charge borrow); Nathan et al. and SSRN pages were not opened in full (search summaries only); FINRA days-to-cover is not applied (see cost table). Sources found only through web-search summaries (Nathan-Suominen-Tasa SSRN 6426026, Burt-Duchin-Hrdlicka SSRN 4636749, Hou 2007, Ben-David et al. 2018) are in external-brief.json/source cards as search_snippet_only and are not bound here.
negative_experiments_checked: grep of reports/research for dual class, lead lag, IBS, intramonth: (1) reports/research/iterations/h20260924_01_etf_dip_reversion/decision-record.md: 0/24 index-ETF dip-reversion sleeves pass G1/G1p, IBS D1 shows a signal-level effect that fails the frozen sleeve gate and the random-entry placebo (58th-92nd percentile vs 95th); (2) reports/research/signal-cards/rev_5d.md: 5-day reversal has no tradable tier at 20 bp (IC 0.006-0.010); (3) h20260928_05_registry_etf_batch2 and h20260928_06_registry_stock_batch3 (both listed these rows as not_executable, none tested the short leg); (4) T-20260929-32 gap fade: daily full turnover loses to spread plus borrow (+11.5 bp gross vs -38.5 bp net per day), hence the low-turnover-only designs here; (5) T-20260929-51: ETF beta-hedged short spreads fail after 0.5%/yr borrow (IWM anchor 0.39). The difference here: market-neutral pairs and spreads that were never tested with a short leg, at weekly/monthly or event-driven turnover.
cost_and_execution_assumptions: Close signal -> next open fill. Judged cost: frozen 10 bp per side per leg (20 bp stress for CAGR positivity), plus borrow fee per short leg by prior-session 21d median dollar volume (>=50M: 0.5%/yr, 5M-50M: 2%/yr, below 5M not shortable; ETFs 0.5%/yr) charged as |w|*rate/252 per session; also reported: main cost 5 bp + half trailing-21d Abdi-Ranaldo spread and stress 10 bp + full spread. Short eligibility: close >= 5 USD and 21d dollar volume >= 5M; excluded when ineligible (pair flat, or trade skipped). Prices pass sanitize_price_matrices defaults and a signal-date split-like filter. Overlay convention as h20260929_51: cash-financed, SHY weight 0, reported Sharpe is the overlay's excess Sharpe; K2 sleeve adds the T-bill collateral return. BRK.A/BRK.B excluded (BRK.A about 700k USD per share cannot be shorted fractionally); MKC.V, GEF.B, BF.A (dollar volume below 5M) can only be the long leg. Scripts: scripts/run_h20260929_37_ls_short_unlocked.py reusing screen_lane windows, offsets, K2 machinery, DSR and t32's spread_wide/is_split_like_ratio unedited.
stop_condition: Per candidate: K1 = anchor >= 1.1882 and stress >= 0.6447 and median 20 bp after-borrow CAGR > 0 in both windows; K2 = S3 blend edge >= 0.05 in both windows; strong = K2 edge >= 0.10 both or K1 with anchor >= 1.4853 and stress >= 0.8059; watch_recent = anchor >= 1.1882 without K1; keep and watch tiers additionally need the candidate anchor Sharpe above the maximum of its 20 random placebo seeds (else reject_placebo). Direction closes as refuted if no candidate in it reaches K1, K2 or watch_recent. Thresholds frozen now; candidate list frozen at 16, controls (3 mirrors, 3 random-placebo families) counted in DSR trials (22).

sources.claim: Yang (South African Journal of Business Management 2025): GOOGL/GOOG spread modelled as an OU process 2015-2024 shows statistically significant twin-stock arbitrage profits (expected returns 8.71%-8.36%, Sharpe 5.4-5.6 under a stated transaction cost of 0.001 per year, robust to RDS.A/RDS.B), half-life about 4.8 days, no shorting-cost or borrow modelling visible.
sources.applicability: Only public evidence that a same-firm class spread mean reverts (GOOG/GOOGL, 2015-2024); motivates a z-score pair on daily closes.
sources.limitations: Half-life of ~5 days means a monthly or weekly rebalanced z-score trade is much slower than the paper OU horizon; a 0.001 cost is not comparable to 5-10 bp per side per leg.

cheapest_decisive_test.action: Run scripts/run_h20260929_37_ls_short_unlocked.py once under scripts/run_capped.sh --mem 1.8G (about 70 symbols of SIP daily, minutes) over all 16 preregistered candidates, their mirrors and 20 random placebo seeds each, borrow deducted.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: At least one non-placebo candidate reaches K1, K2 or watch_recent as frozen in cost-table.json and beats the maximum of its 20 random placebos.
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: No candidate reaches any tier after borrow at 10 bp, or the random placebos match the rule; the direction is then closed as refuted (or evidence_too_weak if the published premise itself could not be located, as for direction A).
